seoTitle: Brevard Public Schools Calendar 2025-2026: Holidays, Breaks & PDF
seoDescription: Brevard Public Schools 2025-2026 calendar with Aug 11 first day, May 27 last day, Friday early release, Spring Break, hurricane make-up note, PDF and ICS.
calendarNotes: Brevard Public Schools starts the 2025-2026 school year for students on Monday, August 11, 2025 and ends the student year on Wednesday, May 27, 2026. Kindergarten begins August 14 and pre-kindergarten begins August 18. Thanksgiving Break runs November 24-28, Winter Break runs December 22-January 2 with students and teachers returning January 5, and Spring Break runs March 23-27. The official calendar totals 180 pupil days and 190 teacher paid days and links families to a separate document identifying Hurricane Make-up Days.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Brevard Public Schools start in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: The first day of school for Brevard Public Schools students is Monday, August 11, 2025.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for Brevard Public Schools in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The last student day is Wednesday, May 27, 2026. The teacher post-planning and last teacher day is Thursday, May 28, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Brevard Spring Break in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs Monday, March 23 through Friday, March 27, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When do Brevard kindergarten and pre-kindergarten students start in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: The first day of kindergarten is Thursday, August 14, 2025. The first day of pre-kindergarten is Monday, August 18, 2025.

calendarFaqs.q: Does Brevard have early release Fridays in 2025-2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. The official 2025-2026 calendar lists many Friday early release days, beginning with the first early release day on Friday, August 22, 2025.

calendarFaqs.q: Where are Brevard hurricane make-up days listed?
calendarFaqs.a: The official district calendar links to a separate document identifying Hurricane Make-up Days. Families should check that district source after any storm closure.
